Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the document or template.

Format.name: Format
Format.definition: Format of the document or template, such as PDF, XML, XSLT.

Enclosure.name: Enclosure
Enclosure.definition: Binary file representing the enclosed document or template, such as a PDF file, image file, XML file, MT message.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Digital signature of the enclosed binary file.
